build.runner:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
trial=/data/jzzeng/hf-cold-master-qualified-20261107
previous=/data/jzzeng/direct-lr-weighted-20261106
source=$previous/source
out=$trial/build-receipt
exec 9>/data/jzzeng/direct-range-anchor-20261105/compile-owner.lock
flock -w 60 9
test -s "$trial/source.tar.gz"
mkdir -p "$out" "$trial/tmp"
exec > "$out/driver.log" 2>&1
export PATH=/home/jzzeng/.local/bin:/home/jzzeng/miniconda3/bin:/group/software/cuda-12.9.1/bin:/usr/bin:/bin
cache=/home/jzzeng/.local/bin/sccache
"$cache" --version > "$out/cache-version.txt"
export SCCACHE_SERVER_UDS="$trial/tmp/cache-$$.sock" SCCACHE_IDLE_TIMEOUT=3600
setsid env SCCACHE_START_SERVER=1 SCCACHE_NO_DAEMON=1 "$cache" 9>&- > "$out/cache-server.log" 2>&1 &
server=$!
modified=0
finish() {
  status=$?
  trap - EXIT
  set +e
  "$cache" --show-stats > "$out/cache-after.txt" 2>&1 || true
  if [[ "$modified" == 1 ]]; then
    tar -mxzf "$previous/integrated-source.tar.gz" -C "$source"
    python - "$previous/integrated-source.tar.gz" "$trial/source.tar.gz" "$source" "$out/restored-extra-files.json" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, sys, tarfile
from pathlib import Path
with tarfile.open(sys.argv[1]) as original, tarfile.open(sys.argv[2]) as candidate:
    old = {Path(member.name).as_posix().removeprefix('./') for member in original if member.isfile()}
    removed = []
    for member in candidate:
        relative = Path(member.name)
        assert not relative.is_absolute() and '..' not in relative.parts
        name = relative.as_posix().removeprefix('./')
        if not member.isfile() or name in old:
            continue
        destination = Path(sys.argv[3]) / relative
        if destination.exists():
            payload = candidate.extractfile(member).read()
            assert hashlib.sha256(destination.read_bytes()).digest() == hashlib.sha256(payload).digest(), name
            destination.unlink()
            removed.append(name)
Path(sys.argv[4]).write_text(json.dumps(removed, indent=2) + '\n')
PY
    tar -xzf "$previous/integrated-repaired-runtime.tar.gz" -C "$source"
    sha256sum "$source/build/libgenerativeqc.so" > "$out/restored-runtime.sha256"
  fi
  kill -- "-$server" 2>/dev/null || true
  wait "$server" 2>/dev/null || true
  printf '%s\n' "$status" > "$out/exit-code.txt"
  date -Is > "$out/completed-at.txt"
  exit "$status"
}
trap finish EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM
for attempt in {1..100}; do
  [[ -S "$SCCACHE_SERVER_UDS" ]] && break
  kill -0 "$server"
  sleep .1
done
[[ -S "$SCCACHE_SERVER_UDS" ]]
"$cache" --show-stats > "$out/cache-before.txt"
cd "$source"
test "$(sha256sum build/libgenerativeqc.so | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = '4c73bcf8a409a15362355d290695e7866c3a2b28753a42a1d61c91aba4ffe83a'
test ! -e src/scf/cuda/direct_source_layout.hpp
modified=1
tar -mxzf "$trial/source.tar.gz" -C .
python - "$trial/source-identity.txt" <<'PY'
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from tools.generate_build_identity import _inventory, _source_identity
root = Path.cwd()
actual = _source_identity(root, _inventory(root, root / 'cmake/GenerativeQCSourceIdentity.json'))
assert actual == Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text().strip(), actual
PY
timeout --kill-after=20s 180 cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/bin/g++-12 \
  -DCMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER=/group/software/cuda-12.9.1/bin/nvcc \
  -DCMAKE_CUDA_HOST_COMPILER=/usr/bin/g++-12 \
  -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER="$cache" -DCMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER_LAUNCHER="$cache" \
  '-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=80-real;120-real' \
  -DGENERATIVEQC_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DGENERATIVEQC_BUILD_CLI=OFF \
  -DGENERATIVEQC_ENABLE_CUDA=ON -DGENERATIVEQC_ENABLE_NATIVE_STATIONARY_CUDA=ON \
  -DGENERATIVEQC_CUDA_DIRECT_DEVICE_LINK=ON -DGENERATIVEQC_COMPRESS_CUDA_FATBINS=OFF \
  -DOpenBLAS_DIR=/data/jzzeng/portable-integration-20261101/provider/scipy_openblas32/lib/cmake/openblas \
  -DPython3_EXECUTABLE=/home/jzzeng/miniconda3/bin/python > "$out/configure.log" 2>&1
timeout --kill-after=30s 5400 cmake --build build --verbose --target generativeqc -j 12 > "$out/build.log" 2>&1
mkdir -p "$trial/source/build"
cp -L build/libgenerativeqc.so "$trial/source/build/libgenerativeqc.so.0.1.0"
ln -sf libgenerativeqc.so.0.1.0 "$trial/source/build/libgenerativeqc.so.0"
ln -sf libgenerativeqc.so.0 "$trial/source/build/libgenerativeqc.so"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$source/build:/data/jzzeng/portable-integration-20261101/provider/scipy_openblas32/lib:/group/software/cuda-12.9.1/lib64"
python - "$trial/source-identity.txt" "$out/identity.json" <<'PY'
import ctypes, hashlib, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
library = ctypes.CDLL(str(Path('build/libgenerativeqc.so').resolve()))
library.generativeqc_get_source_identity.restype = ctypes.c_char_p
identity = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text().strip()
assert library.generativeqc_get_source_identity().decode() == identity
Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps({'source_identity': identity,
    'library_sha256': hashlib.file_digest(Path('build/libgenerativeqc.so').open('rb'), 'sha256').hexdigest()}, indent=2)+'\n')
PY
tar -czf "$trial/runtime.tar.gz" -C "$source" build/libgenerativeqc.so build/libgenerativeqc.so.0 build/libgenerativeqc.so.0.1.0
tar -xzf "$trial/source.tar.gz" -C "$trial/source"

  '--generate-code=arch=compute_80,code=sm_80' \
